Re:Earth was benchmarked with a deterministic 360-stop route. The inventory contains 1,525,862,980 unique compressed bytes and 2,941,171,106 estimated decoded bytes; 12 exact AB/BA paired blocks completed.
No reachable production Meshopt terrain source was confirmed.
Ion 2325107 is confirmed production Draco/KTX2 content, but no exact-ref 1 GB paired route or decoded-byte inventory exists.
Public I3S metadata and payload observations did not establish a stable production Draco geometry corpus.
The browser memory API was unavailable in prior runs; no several-gigabyte exact-ref stress run has produced usable peak process/ArrayBuffer memory measurements.

productionBehaviorProven: Re:Earth contains production-style GLB tiles that explicitly use EXT_meshopt_compression.
Ion asset 4547222 is a complete multi-gigabyte SPZ corpus with 3,410 content GLBs and a full transfer inventory.
Ion asset 2325107 is a complete multi-gigabyte Draco/KTX2 corpus with 3,902 content GLBs.
The exact 12-pair Re:Earth route processes at least 1 GB of unique Meshopt GLBs in every sample, with 2.941 GB estimated decoded buffer data in the retained route inventory.
The exact 12-pair small-fixture comparison shows a repeatable first-use readiness cost and improved SPZ frame continuity for the candidate.
mediumFixtureBehavior: Meshopt first-use readiness is approximately 23 ms slower in the exact paired confirmatory fixtures.
SPZ tower readiness is approximately 11 ms slower while the maximum animation-frame gap is approximately 142 ms lower.
syntheticStressBehavior: The 1/10/60/200 Meshopt bufferView study is non-monotonic and synthetic.
The selected SPZ route shows 12-18 outstanding decode tasks, but no measured memory peak and no full-route regression.
remainingAcquisitionGaps: No compliant large-data paired SPZ route using the exact baseline.
No compliant large-data paired Draco/KTX2 route.
No confirmed stable I3S Draco route.
No stress run with usable memory-pressure evidence.
conclusion.mergeDecision: Large-production validation is partially complete: the Re:Earth Meshopt streamed route now has a valid exact 12-pair result, while SPZ, Draco/KTX2, memory-pressure stress, high-bufferView individual-content scaling, terrain, and I3S Draco remain unvalidated.
